headline: Approved a live poultry market at 785 Page Boulevard; continued zoning changes on data centers and parking lots.
summary: A live poultry market at 785 Page Boulevard was approved after a hearing, where the health department said it was comfortable with the plan. A used car special permit at 1469 State Street and a special permit amendment for a gas station at 1313 Boston Road were also approved. Proposed zoning changes, including rules for data centers and surface parking lots, were continued to a later meeting.
decisions: Approved a live poultry market at 785 Page Boulevard, 13 yes votes.
Approved an amendment to the special permit for the gas station at 1313 Boston Road, 13 yes votes.
Approved a change of owner for the used car sales special permit at 1469 State Street, 12 yes votes with one absent.
Withdrew the temporary sign rules from the zoning changes, 13 yes votes.
Continued the zoning ordinance changes to the next hearings meeting, 11 yes votes, one absent.
discussion: Questions on the poultry market at 785 Page Boulevard covered bird flu, how birds are handled, odor and noise, and parking. The health department said it was comfortable with the plan, and the neighborhood group supported the project.

Questions on the zoning changes covered how many data centers the city has and whether the new rules would reach them. Temporary sign rules were questioned over limits on yard signs and were then withdrawn.
Members asked about trailers over 20 feet in residential zones and about setbacks for accessory dwelling units. Some members asked for more time to review the changes before voting.
A rule requiring a family child care operator to live at the property was questioned as unclear. Staff said the rule would not change the rules for brick-and-mortar day care centers.
